issues.detail: The Greek 'μοναι πολλαι' (many dwellings/places to stay) is translated as 'nhiều chỗ ở' (many places to live/stay). However, the Vietnamese translation of the second clause 'nếu chẳng vậy' (if not so) misinterprets the Greek 'εἰ δὲ μη εἶπον' (if I had not said). The Greek structure implies a conditional hypothetical: 'If I had not said [to you] that I am going to prepare a place for you.' The Vietnamese 'nếu chẳng vậy' suggests 'if it weren't for that' or 'otherwise,' which slightly shifts the logical connection of the conditional.
